tasks.RemainingPaperAreaCalculation: Subtract the total area of the semicircles from the area of the square to find the remaining paper area.
tasks.SemicircleAreaCalculation: Calculate the combined area of the two semicircles.
tasks.SquareAreaCalculation: Calculate the area of the square paper.

Questions.content: What is the radius of each semicircle, and how does it relate to the side of the square? The current TG assumes the radius but does not specify how it was derived from the given information.

Answers.content:
The radius of each semicircle is half the side length of the square. Given that the side length of the square is 20 cm, the radius \( r \) of each semicircle is:

\[ r = \frac{20}{2} = 10 \text{ cm} \]

This relationship directly links the dimensions of the square to the semicircles drawn on its sides.
